key_idea: A multiset of letters can be rearranged into a palindrome iff at most one letter has an odd count.
sketch: Count occurrences of each of the 26 letters and count how many are odd. Answer yes iff that number is at most 1 (zero for even length, one for odd length - both covered by the same test). O(|s|) time, no pitfalls beyond reading a 1e5-length string.
